constraints: Current owner authorizes this completion journey and local completion controls only.
One product source writer or test runner at a time; no parallel render lane.
Preserve all pre-existing staged, unstaged and untracked work.
No real voice API calls, quota or backend changes.
No modal, forced scroll, focus replacement or account persistence claim.
No push, deployment or main changes; owned verified commits only, honoring stage-helper refusal.
Do not advance review snapshots for unreviewed pre-existing changes.

evidence.scope: Completion regions only; global metadata/performance are excluded from this focused audit.

evidence.limitations: Some early region rows lack redundant label-dimension capture. Actual label behavior/dimension checks and later normal renders provide target evidence. Physical phones and native screen readers unverified.

testHarnessNotes: Initial request-count assertion assumed one status request; corrected to compare counts before/after toggles.
Measurements now wait for generation-stage positioning before final-toggle checks.
Undo of an earlier reward may change absolute scrollY through native anchoring; meaningful acceptance preserves input viewport position/focus and forbids explicit scroll calls.

Initial generic audit summary was empty/misleading for focused region records. Replaced with explicit measured region report and correct viewport/build provenance; invalid summary is not verification evidence.

Full run also exposed a pre-existing result-state assertion requiring zero input controls (desktop/mobile). WD16 supersedes it: keep no fieldset/select/non-checkbox input controls and assert native title-labeled unchecked result checkboxes. Capture-stage zero-checkbox test is retained.

ownershipStage.reason: Essential source hunks overlap other sessions’ pre-existing edits. Entire functional package left uncommitted; no bypass or partial dependent commit.
